summary: Short, steep north kerb on a through road with no parked cars.
reasons: Through road, no cars park here

drivers.seclusion: Houses sit 13 m back behind hedges and a pool; neighbours would notice.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb abuts the lane with no verge or pull-off; only 37 m long.
drivers.traffic: Wide two-lane road with centre markings and overhead wires.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along the north kerb; parking is in a car park to the south.

sun_shade: Mostly open; tree shade from the east.
